name: Business OS
description: Business OS — governed L5 extension over the thin L0 record/artifact/identity/audit contract. Default-excluded until each module passes its effect-verification gate.

effectVerification.policy: A module is included only when its deterministic effect tests pass against a scratch database. Unproven modules are excluded from default loads.

capabilityStatement: Records, artifacts, outcomes, approvals and AI-worker automation over local-first business records, through the canonical execution envelope and single-writer store. No second orchestration engine; no simulated success.
knownLimitations: Not a competing ERP: real systems of record integrate via MCP. Hosted control plane is Phase 11+.
